companies.description: Stock tickers separated by comma. Examples: GOOGL=Alphabet, AAPL=Apple, TSLA=Tesla, MSFT=Microsoft, AMZN=Amazon. For 13F-HR, use institutional investor tickers like BRK-B (Berkshire Hathaway)

download_settings.description: year_range supports: '2025' (single year) or '2020-2025' (range including both years)

conversion_settings.description: JSON conversion settings for creating AI-friendly format

user_agent.description: Please replace with your actual contact email for SEC compliance

_comments.form_type: Supported values: '10-K' for annual reports, '13F-HR' for institutional holdings reports
_comments.13f_example_tickers: BRK.B, JPM, BAC, GS (major institutional investors)
